integrity_notes: The universal classification is proved by explicit singleton-output and zero-output analysis.
Finite direct-subsequence and exhaustive codebook checks are supplemental.
No external independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only linear ternary words with exactly one 1 and one 2, exactly one deletion, and n >= 2.
The optimal-code count is given as a finite permutation sum and subset recurrence, not a closed-form asymptotic.
Full text of Tenengolts (1984) was not available for material comparison; historical priority remains uncertain.
title: Permutation-successions classification of optimal ternary sparse deletion codes
